profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-stack engineer who has worked with a vast variety of technologies and picks up new ones easily - experience in backend, frontend, native android, and even dabbling in hardware.

Currently on vacation, but will be looking for new opportunities come August 2024.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Lead frontend development of greenfield project to re-architect a legacy codebase to be in line with modern React standards
- Improved engineering tools and CI/CD pipelines to modernize development efforts
- Mentored junior engineers on architectural design and coding style guides
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · React Native · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Git · React.js · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed highly trafficked front-ends in React Native to serve Gopuff's millions of monthly users.
- Led development of several large scale projects aimed at both the end user, and engineering organization at large.
- Led development of Product Detail Page overhaul, one of the most traveled to pages of the site
- Led development of Starbucks integration, estimated to be a billion dollar partnership over the next five years

Designer and winner of Gopuff Hackathon 2023 with the Surprise Me feature, launched officially later that year, which reduced cart abandonment rates and gave new tools to marketing.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · GraphQL · TypeScript · React Native · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Git · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Led Android development team in development of four native Android apps
- Developed Ruby backend api endpoints
- Worked closely with CTO and CEO in quickly achieving product goals
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Ruby on Rails · Kotlin · Android Development · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed Java based microservices to handle advertisement information on the Tripadvisor site, as well as tools for third party advertising partners
- Developed frontend components to serve and trigger advertising analytics

Unfortunately was caught in COVID related downsizing, and went on to work with the same team lead at both HaulHub and Gopuff.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · Java · JavaScript · Git · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Developed backend microservices for warehousing operations and international shipping logistics.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Back-End Web Development · C# · Git

positions.description: Skills: Programming · Back-End Web Development · Front-End Development · C# · JavaScript · Git

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Interactive Media and Game Development Double Major

honors.title: People's Choice Hackathon Winner
honors.description: In Gopuff's 2023 Hackathon I designed and solo developed the Surprise Me feature, which won an award thanks to its focus on the user experience. It was the only solo team project that won an award, and was shipped to production soon after.

organizations.name: Beta Theta Pi Fraternity at WPI

organizations.description: One of the Founding Fathers of WPI Colony. Brother from 2013 - present, VP of Risk Management from January 2014 - Present.
